contract: The /new URL's card[name] and card[content] reach the create form and the stored card.

card_class_fetch.source:
card.assign_attributes card_opts if params[:assign] && card&.real?
        card&.include_set_modules
        card
      end

      def uri_fetch_opts params
        Env.hash(params[:card]).tap do |opts|
          opts[:type] ||= params[:type] if params[:type] # for /new/:type shortcut.
          opts[:name] ||= Name[params[:mark]]&.tr "_", " "
        end
      end
    end
  end

  def content_field
    with_nest_mode :normal do
      # by changing nest mode to normal, we ensure that editors (eg image
      # previews) can render core views.
      output [_render_conflict_tracker, _render_input]
    end
  end

    text_area :content, rows: 5, class: "d0-card-content",

# NAME HANDLING

  def new_view_name
    if new_name_prompt?
      new_name_formgroup
    elsif !autoname?
      hidden_field_tag "card[name]", card.name
    end
  end

  def new_name_formgroup
    output _render_name_formgroup,
           hidden_field_tag("name_prompt", true)
